card.name: Digits inside large counts of things
card.fires_on: A digit partway through a multi-digit number, such as the 7 in 107,270 or the 0 in 1400. It appears in descriptions of building sizes or counts of people, planes, tanks and companies.

modes.label: Building sizes
modes.description: A digit inside a floor area or building size figure.
modes.example: City Hall contains 10<<7>>,270 square feet of office

modes.label: Counts of people or machines
modes.description: A digit inside a count of physicians, planes, tanks or papers.

card.writes: It promotes place nouns such as mailbox, bedroom and office, and suppresses hospital words, which suggests it prepares for the unit being counted.
card.plain: It fires on the middle digits of big numbers that count buildings, rooms, people or equipment.
